question: Reference reconstruction from every non-excluded event in the chart.
assumptions: No segmentation and no claim of structural truth.
failure_modes: Usually ambiguous; chart-wide frequency is not authority.

question: Historical ±4 beat contextual reference.
assumptions: Four beats is an external legacy convention, never truth.
failure_modes: Window edges are arbitrary and can mix or split structure.

question: Reconstruct an exact categorical event token from exact previous/next token context.
assumptions: Exact equality is intentionally narrow; target and its group are excluded from donors.
failure_modes: May abstain frequently and cannot recover fuzzy motif identity.

question: Represent non-contiguous recurrence of exact event-token sequences.
assumptions: Block length is an explicit research hypothesis; recurrence is not segmentation.
failure_modes: Exact identity may have low human coverage.

question: Propose an exact event-anchored boundary between two stable token runs.
assumptions: A boundary is inferred, not mapper-authored section truth.
failure_modes: Sensitive to minimum run length and blind to gradual change.

question: Sensitivity configuration for stable token runs.
assumptions: No configuration is selected as a winner.
failure_modes: Higher abstention and fewer proposed boundaries.

question: Approximate recurrence.
assumptions: Would require an unjustified similarity metric and threshold.
failure_modes: Can manufacture recurrence and hide exact false merges.

question: General change-point optimization.
assumptions: Penalty/objective preferences are not justified by mapper evidence in this phase.
failure_modes: A popular algorithm could become a magic segmenter.

question: Combine recurrence and segmentation.
assumptions: The two component questions must first be measured independently.
failure_modes: Combination could conceal a failure in either component.
